name: Cluster and a sun
description: The free cluster with a fixed sun at the center (mass 300, as much as the whole cluster). Space is no longer the same everywhere, so the bodies' total momentum P changes as the sun pulls them; but every direction around the sun is still alike, so the angular momentum about the sun (the origin) stays constant. About any other point it changes: move Statistics' point Q off the sun to see it. The energy still holds.
